manifest.name: Apple Music
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Search and play Apple Music, and open music.apple.com links.
manifest.requirement: Needs an Apple Music subscription. Sign in with your Apple Account.

developerToken.label: MusicKit developer token
developerToken.description: Get a token from the Apple Developer Portal (needs an Apple Developer account). It lets Parachord search the Apple Music catalog directly.

storefront.label: Storefront (Country)
storefront.description: Apple Music storefront code (e.g., us, gb, jp)

account.signInHint: Sign in with your Apple Account to play from Apple Music
account.advancedHint: Add a developer token for faster, more reliable search.
account.advancedSavedHint: Using your developer token for faster search.
